## 📋 Description of Changes
Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes. Also list any relevant motivation and context.

Fixes # (issue)

## 🧪 Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] 🎨 UI/UX styling improvement

## 🔒 Security & Quality Checklist
- [ ] Backend tests pass cleanly (`pytest tests/ -v`).
- [ ] Frontend build succeeds (`npm run build`).
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, API keys, or credentials committed.
- [ ] New features include corresponding unit/integration tests if applicable.

Add screenshots or GIFs showing the UI/UX changes.
